note: Serbia: nationals of the countries listed enter without a visa for 90 days (in 180 for most), 30, 30 in a year, or 14 (Hong Kong). Kosovo's passports aren't valid for entry (Kosovars may enter on an identity card: not modelled, so a visa is taken). Everyone else needs a visa (holders of Schengen, UK or US visas or residence may enter visa-free: not modelled). Read from Wikipedia's copy. Checked on 2026-11-03 against the Ministry of Foreign Affairs' own page for each country (ordinary passports): it gives every figure held but Kosovo's, for which the Ministry has no page; Kosovo's stands on Wikipedia's copy.
